title: Form actions
summary: The bar of buttons under a form, aligned start, end or between, and sticky to the bottom of a long form.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Sticks to the bottom of the scrolling area with a top edge, clearing the phone home indicator.

slots.name: status
slots.description: A status message such as "Unsaved changes".

a11y: Plain layout; the status text is not a live region (use a Notice for announcements). On a phone the buttons of a sticky bar share the width.
